# Atlas CRM

> Atlas CRM is an AI-powered cloud CRM platform by LiAfrik (SPC FZC, Dubai, UAE), unifying sales, customer service, marketing, and AI-driven automation for businesses in Africa, the Middle East, and worldwide.

Atlas CRM combines core CRM functionality (contacts, leads, deals, invoices, tickets, knowledge base) with an integrated AI assistant (Ask Atlas), real workflow automation, and a marketplace of real, working integrations (payments, messaging, e-commerce, support platforms).

## Pricing
Four flat monthly plans per organization, in USD: Starter ($19), Growth ($49), Pro ($119), Enterprise ($219). All plans include a 14-day free trial, no credit card required. Full details: https://atlas.liafrik.com/legal/pricing
